descriptionHtml:
The Annual General Meeting of the IEEE Student Branch Chapter University of Peradeniya was held on 10th February 2021 through the Zoom platform with the participation of Dr. Ruwan Ranaweera, Senior Lecturer of the Electrical and Electronic Engineering Department, University of Peradeniya, and Advisor and Senior Treasurer of the society. Thereby the former members concluded their duties and handed them over to the new office bearers marking the inauguration of the term 2021.

The new office bearers were elected and selected for the year 2021.
Mr. Dilshan Muthukuda was selected as the new chairperson, Mr. Vanodhya Warnasooriya was selected as the new vice-chair, and Miss. Nanduni Upendra as the secretary of the society. The meeting concluded with the hope of continuing a successful year ahead.
